Live: Pregame · World Series G1, series 0–0. First pitch Fri 10/23 7:00 PM CT, American Family Field (retractable roof; status not announced), FOX. SP: Jacob Misiorowski (MIL, R; 16-5, 1.80 ERA, 252 K in the regular season; two postseason starts, 8.1 IP, 3 ER, neither reaching 5 IP) vs Nick Martinez (TB, R; 15-6, 3.10 ERA, 109 K; 9 IP / 3 R in two postseason starts). TB announced Martinez on Thu 10/22 and moved Drew Rasmussen to G2 on full rest, so picks recorded before that assumed Rasmussen (rule 9: stale on TB-pitcher-dependent markets). MIL last played the NLCS G4 sweep; TB closed the ALCS 2 days ago. MLB v2 model: TB 2.90 – MIL 4.32 runs (7.22), MIL 69.4%, Over 6.5 58.4%.
